facts.fact: The Bank of Sierra Leone directive of 2 September 2025 set 31 December 2025 as the deadline for all commercial banks and financial institutions to require a valid NCRA-issued NIN for account opening, deposits, withdrawals and transfers, to strengthen identity verification and KYC.
The article says the telecommunications sector had an earlier NIN compliance deadline of 31 October 2025.
